title: Rav Kahana, Brother of Rav Yehudah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 111b: “He sat before Rav Huna.” But Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be: “Rav Kahana sat behind Rav Yehudah,” and so it is in the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson Chullin 111b paragraph has Rav Kahana, brother of Rav Yehudah, sitting before Rav Huna. Replacing “brother” with “behind” and changing the seating relation is Hyman’s proposed reading, attributed by him to the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim.

The consulted Chullin 111b paragraph names Rav Kahana, brother of Rav Yehudah, sitting before Rav Huna. Hyman’s proposed replacement of “brother” by “behind,” the changed seated-before person, and his Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim reports remain his correction and reports; those apparatus witnesses were not freshly collated.
